prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite atlas for FirstMate's ship Deck. The attached existing crew-bosun PNG is the EXACT pose/layout/style reference, not a background. Create a new FIRST MATE identity by changing the character's clothing while preserving the 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 full-body poses and their order and orientations. Match this modest 16-bit pixel-art style: one logical pixel outline, simple chunky flat colour clusters, readable small face and no blur or smooth illustration. Logical atlas 128x160, each cell 32x40; deliver enlarged pixel art at 1024x1280 (8x logical). Character should be 32 logical pixels tall, with same ordinary crew proportions, not a big chibi head. First mate: compact navy officer's bicorne hat with gold edge (no tall plume), open navy knee-length coat with cream lapels and two gold buttons, a burgundy sash at waist, cream shirt, dark trousers, brown boots, warm tan face, short dark beard. Hat and shoulders stay narrow enough for reference frames. Same person, hat and uniform in EVERY frame. Reference pose order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom: row1 front-facing walking left foot forward / front passing feet together / front-facing walking right foot forward / other front passing; row2 RIGHT-facing profile walking left foot forward / RIGHT-facing profile standing at ease with feet together and arms down / RIGHT-facing walking right foot forward / RIGHT-facing other passing; row3 front-facing neutral standing arms relaxed / leaning right arms forward hauling a taut short rope / leaning back pulling same rope / attentive front three-quarter standing with folded hands; row4 back-facing climbing one arm raised / back-facing climbing other arm raised / right-facing lookout hand shading eyes / thoughtful front-three-quarter hand at chin. Keep rope inside its cell. Everything wholly within equal cells, generous transparent gutters, all soles at 90 percent of their cell height. No ground shadows, wheel, ship, backdrop, labels, words, symbols, borders or gridlines. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, not a checkerboard painted into the image. Restrained existing ship palette: dark navy #151E2D and #22395A, cream #E1D7B5, muted brass ochre and warm rust reds, brown boots, peach/tan skin. Change only the sailor identity, keep the reference pose sheet structure.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite sheet, FirstMate character for Sakura setting. Input images are two existing Sakura crew lanes, the elder and padded sailor, STYLE/PROPORTION/POSE references. Create a distinct senior FIRST MATE, not ordinary crew: an indigo haori officer's coat with cream lapel edging, a narrow ochre-gold sash, plum inner robe, charcoal trousers and simple brown sandals; a low dark Japanese eboshi-style officer cap, not a big straw hat or tall helmet; mature warm tan face, short tidy grey beard. Consistent outfit, cap and person in every frame. Match existing tiny 32-pixel-tall Edo-era merchant sailor pixel art exactly: restrained flat pixel clusters, fine single-pixel dark outlines, no dither, no soft edges. TRUE transparent background. 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows, all 16 complete bodies centered in their cells with wide transparent gutters, soles on same baseline in each row. Do not render the extremely wide reference strip; rearrange its fifteen poses in this production 4x4 grid so they can be registered later. Row1: neutral FRONT stand arms relaxed; front walking left foot forward; front passing feet together; front walking right foot forward. Row2: RIGHT-facing profile stand arms at ease; right profile walking left foot forward; right profile passing feet together; right profile walking right foot forward. Row3: pulling short taut rope right with arms forward; leaning back hauling that rope; front attentive waiting hands folded; front seated cross-legged resting (shorter than standing). Row4: BACK-facing climbing left arm up; BACK-facing climbing right arm up; right-facing lookout hand shading eyes; front standing with ONE HAND RAISED in calm greeting (optional new-request pose). Same crew scale through all cells; crouch and seated remain shorter; raised hands stay inside cell. Reference palette: indigo, deep plum, golden ochre, cream and warm tan; no neon or modern uniform. No extra props beyond the short ropes, no ship wheel, stage, ground shadows, labels, text, borders, painted checkerboards or grid lines. Aim for logical 32x40 cells, 128x160 total; deliver enlarged clean pixel art at 1024x1280.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: first-mate officer sprite sheet for FirstMate Ghost ship pixel-art game. The attached existing spectral crew sheet is the exact STYLE, PALETTE, SMALL SCALE and POSE reference. Create a distinct senior FIRST MATE for the same ghostly crew: a pale mint friendly skeletal face under a compact dark teal officer bicorne, broad pale ivory high collar, two conspicuous muted old-gold epaulettes, double-breasted emerald long coat with twin gold button rows, and a diagonal ivory officer sash. These contrasting ivory/gold uniform features must visibly distinguish this officer from the ordinary ragged green pirate crew. Same consistent character in every pose; no crown, weapon, skull-and-crossbones, rank text or scary gore. A slim slightly translucent ghost lower body fading to a short wisp tail instead of heavy opaque legs, exactly as existing reference. Crisp 16-bit pixel clusters, outline one logical pixel, designed for just 24x28 logical pixel cells and 25px-tall characters, not a smooth illustration. Requested layout: FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, exactly EIGHT full-body figures, ample transparent gutters, identical scale and baseline. Row1: neutral standing with arms relaxed, THREE-QUARTER FACING RIGHT; right-facing walking/spectral gliding stride A; right-facing stride B with opposite arms; right-facing leaning forward hauling a short rope, arms forward. Row2: right-facing leaning back pulling that rope; front-facing attentive waiting hands folded; BACK-facing climbing with one arm raised; front-facing falling arms raised and wisp tail lifted. Entire figure and short rope contained within each cell. Palette ONLY near-black deep teal, emerald, jade, pale icy mint, ivory and tiny desaturated old-gold accents as in reference. Ghostly look through pale mint edges, NOT broad glow, fog or blur. TRUE alpha-transparent background. No sea, ship, wheel, backdrop, floor shadow, frame border, labels, lettering or checkerboard pattern. Deliver clean enlarged pixel artwork, approximately 1024x640. Keep all eight cells separate and uniform; this source will reduce to the same native 192x28 strip and feet anchors as the reference.
